spanish: Y desgrasarán el altar, y tenderán sobre él vestido de púrpura.

findings.issue: Piel of H1878 with the altar as its object licenses clearing the altar of its fat-ashes. desgrasarán fixes that range as removing grease and leaves the ash sense unexpressed.

notes: Conjunctions, the altar, spread upon it, and garment of purple match the remaining tokens.
